تتمالكوا (form VI)
# تَتَمَالَكُوا (tatamālakū) /ta.ta.maː.la.kuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَمَالَكَ (tamālaka)
# تُتَمَالَكُوا (tutamālakū) /tu.ta.maː.la.kuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَمَالَكَ (tamālaka)
